modes: on-demand bounded worker query by name or dos_id
batch confirmation for the engine's known vendor stems into a small committed lookup
decisions.reason: The only register that says an organization is a registered New York corporation, LLC, partnership or nonprofit; 4,315,387 active rows (updated 2026-11-11T14:20:02Z), 30 published fields, 53 entity types. 143 of 300 seeded engine vendors (47.7%) have exactly one state record by exact or stem-equal name. decisions.name: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File, New York (eo_ny.csv)
modes: full warehouse ingest and sharded committed serve artifact
decisions.reason: The only register with an EIN, NTEE code, IRS subsection and (for filers) asset, income and revenue amounts. 125,622 rows, 21,920,529 bytes (21.9 MB), 28 columns, Last-Modified Mon, 09 Nov 2026 05:11:37 GMT; one row per EIN. 37 of 100 nonprofit-looking and 14 of 100 random engine vendor names have an IRS record by stem. It is a bulk CSV on irs.gov, not Socrata, and the IRS search UI is disallowed by robots.txt, so the bulk file is the path.

evidence.observed: page loaded; states cumulative file, most recent IRS information

decisions.name: NYS Department of Labor Contractor Registry Certificates (data.ny.gov i4jv-zkey)
modes: warehouse source and committed serve artifact, doing-business pattern
decisions.reason: Found while checking what else data.ny.gov holds. It lists businesses registered with the Bureau of Public Work to bid on public work: 15,193 rows (all Active, updated daily, last 2026-11-11T10:01:22Z), 17,452,975 bytes for the full pull. It is the only register here that carries sole proprietorships (227) and partnerships (136) next to corporations (10,198) and LLCs (4,468), plus MWBE ownership, debarment flags (35 debarred) and officers. 4 of 100 and 1,219 of 19,506 engine vendor stems (6.2%) match.

evidence.observed: owner New York State Department of Labor; four-year window of active and expired licences

decisions.name: NYC Open Data Prequalified Firms (szkz-syh6), the School Construction Authority prequalified list
modes: warehouse source and committed serve artifact, doing-business pattern
decisions.reason: Metadata says: list of firms qualified to perform work for the School Construction Authority, their trades, and the end date of their qualification. It is not a city-wide or agency-wide prequalification. 6,092 rows (one per firm and MasterFormat trade) = 2,178 distinct firms, weekly, updated 2026-11-06T20:15:24Z, 4,590,032 bytes; qualification end dates run 2026-11-08 to 2029-11-05. It adds facts found nowhere else here: trades, minority, women and local business indicators as the firm reported them, and a contact person. Small enough to carry whole. 2 of 100 and 488 of 19,506 engine vendor stems (2.5%) match; this is a directory facet, not an identity register, so the low join rate does not block it.

evidence.observed: attribution School Construction Authority (SCA); description quoted above

decisions.name: NYC Open Data DCWP Issued Licenses (w7w3-xahh)
decisions.reason: Measured and rejected. 74,271 rows (47,396,636 bytes for the full pull, 11 s), weekly. 3 of 100 and 381 of 19,506 engine vendor stems (1.95%) match on business name or trade name, far below the 0.30 usefulness line. 17,496 rows (23.6%) are Individual licences (tow truck drivers, sightseeing guides, locksmiths) whose business_name is a person's name, so the file is half about people and not about organizations. It carries no EIN or entity type, and its business_name is, per its own metadata, the legal name filed with the State, which the State register already covers authoritatively. Adding it would cost a 47 MB weekly pull for one fact (licence category and status) on about 2% of engine vendors. Reopen if the product needs a licensed-trade filter: it can then be queried live from Socrata by name, the same way the State register is.

evidence.observed: agency DCWP; weekly; business_name described as legal name filed with the NYS Secretary of State

decisions.name: NYS Unified Certification Program Disadvantaged Business Enterprises (data.ny.gov pfeu-dsx6)
decisions.reason: Stale. 2,262 rows, but the dataset's rowsUpdatedAt is 2016-12-02T20:10:22Z while its metadata promises semi-annual posting and time period Current, so nothing has been published for almost ten years. 1 of 100 and 212 of 19,506 engine vendor stems (1.1%) match. decisions.name: NYS Attorney General Charities Bureau registry (charitiesnys.com)
decisions.reason: cannot be ingested: charitiesnys.com now answers 200 and redirects to the Attorney General's site; the registry search is a single-page app at https://charities-search.ag.ny.gov/ (200) whose JavaScript calls https://charities-search-api.ag.ny.gov/api and verifies a Google reCAPTCHA token (action pfc_search, POST /recaptcha/verify) before searching. That is bot detection and is not circumvented. data.ny.gov has no charities dataset (catalog search for 'charities' returned 0). The IRS file above covers federally exempt New York nonprofits, and the DOS register covers New York not-for-profit corporations.

evidence.observed: bundle references recaptcha/verify and api.js?render for the search

decisions.name: Empire State Development M/WBE Directory of Certified Firms (ny.newnycontracts.com)
decisions.reason: cannot be ingested: the host loads on retry (the portal home 200, SearchCertifiedDirectory.asp 200, 35,296 bytes) but the directory is an interactive search form that requires at least one certification type, loads Google reCAPTCHA, and publishes no export, bulk file or documented API; its former path /FrontEnd/VendorSearchPublic.asp returns 404. decisions.name: SAM.gov entity registrations
decisions.reason: cannot be ingested without an API key, and requesting a key is out of scope. https://open.gsa.gov/api/entity-api/ (200) documents requests to api.sam.gov/entity-information with an api_key; public data fields include legal business name, UEI, registration details, physical and mailing addresses, business types, PSC, NAICS and points of contact name and address; an asynchronous extract of up to 1,000,000 records is offered through the same keyed API; a non-federal user with no role gets 10 requests per day and one with a role 1,000. The page describes no keyless public extract. When a key exists later the register fits the contract (register id sam_gov_entities, record id UEI).

evidence.observed: api_key required; rate limits table; Public Data definition; Extract API up to 1,000,000 records
